name: RU58841

protocolDosing.notes: applied as ~1 mL of 5% solution to scalp; no completed human clinical trials; development abandoned by Roussel Uclaf/Hoechst; systemic t½ ~1 h (designed for rapid clearance)

effects: systemic AR antagonism risk at high topical absorption (gynecomastia, libido effects)

mechanismOfAction.summary: Topical nonsteroidal competitive AR antagonist; designed for scalp application with minimal systemic exposure.
mechanismOfAction.description: Competitive androgen receptor antagonist targeting scalp follicle ARs to block DHT-mediated miniaturization in androgenetic alopecia. Designed for minimal systemic absorption — rapid systemic clearance (t½ ~1 h parenteral) when absorbed, intentional design to reduce systemic antiandrogen effects. Development abandoned; no completed randomized controlled trials.
